reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Local court rule designation of family court in circuit
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes majority of circuit and associate circuit judges en banc to designate a family court by local rule.

headings.title: Presiding judge designation of family court divisions and split venue
headings.reviewNote: Directs presiding judge to designate family court divisions, requiring a division in each venue for split venue circuits.

headings.title: Designation of administrative judge for multi-division family courts
headings.reviewNote: Requires presiding judge to designate an administrative judge where more than one division is designated as family court.

headings.title: Circuit judge allocation formula based on population in split venue circuits
headings.reviewNote: Requires at least one family court circuit judge for each block of 160,000 residents in split venue circuits.

headings.title: Removal and reassignment of family court judges by court en banc
headings.reviewNote: Empowers judges of court en banc to remove a family court judge from duties and reassign a replacement judge.

headings.title: Preservation of existing family courts established prior to 2020
headings.reviewNote: Protects all family courts in existence as of December 31, 2019, from elimination.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all 6 subsections and effective-date note (*Effective 12-31-20, see 478.191) governing family court designation, split venue, administrative judges, and preservation of pre-2020 courts.

headings.title: Family court commissioner appointment, terms, and funding limitations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes en banc appointment of commissioners for four-year terms, transitioning juvenile commissioners and limiting new positions.

headings.title: State-funded commissioner appointments in eleventh, thirteenth, and thirty-first circuits
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes state-paid family court commissioners in designated circuits in substitution of reimbursable positions.

headings.title: Commissioner qualifications, compensation, and retirement benefits
headings.reviewNote: Requires commissioners to hold circuit judge qualifications and associate circuit judge compensation and retirement benefits.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all 3 subsections on family court commissioner appointments, state-funded substitutions in circuits 11, 13, and 31, and qualifications/compensation/retirement.

headings.title: Judicial adoption of commissioner findings and notice of rehearing rights
headings.reviewNote: Provides that commissioner findings become court judgments upon judicial adoption and requires notice of rehearing rights.

headings.title: Motion for judicial rehearing, fifteen-day deadline, and forty-five-day denial rule
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes motions for judicial rehearing within 15 days, ruling by judge, and automatic denial after 45 days.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections and constitutional/Rule 130 case annotations (Slay, York, Fowler, Dolan) on commissioner findings, rehearing motions, and 45-day denial text.

headings.title: Administrative judge direction for commissioner case hearings
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes administrative judge or family court judge to direct cases or classes of cases to be heard by commissioners.

headings.title: Designation of hearing locations and venue assignments for commissioners
headings.reviewNote: Empowers court en banc to designate hearing locations, requiring commissioner assignments in each venue for split circuits.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections on directing cases to commissioners and designating hearing locations including split-venue assignments.

headings.title: Desirable judicial qualifications, family law training, and continuing education
headings.reviewNote: Recommends assignment of judges and commissioners desiring service, having proper temperament, and completing training.

headings.title: Superintending appellate review of family court qualifications
headings.reviewNote: Provides that judicial qualifications under section are reviewable under constitutional superintending control of appellate courts.

headings.title: Judicial conduct standards, full-time service, and practice of law ban
headings.reviewNote: Requires commissioners to maintain judicial decorum, devote full time to duties, and refrain from practicing law.

headings.title: For-cause removal of family court commissioners by court en banc
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes en banc removal of commissioners upon proof of crime, misconduct, neglect, corruption, or incompetence.

headings.title: Four-year term of service for designated family court judges
headings.reviewNote: Establishes four-year terms of service for family court judges, subject to consensual extension or shortening.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all 5 subsections on desirable qualifications/training, appellate superintending review, full-time conduct/practice ban, en banc removal, and four-year judge terms.

headings.title: Family court administrator employment upon en banc judicial approval
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes employment of a family court administrator upon approval of majority of judges en banc.

headings.title: Support service duties and multi-circuit cooperative agreements
headings.reviewNote: Defines administrator duties over personnel, home studies, mediation, and inter-circuit cooperative service agreements.

headings.title: Funding of transferred personnel salaries and employee benefits
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that salaries and benefits for transferred personnel are funded pursuant to sections 487.180 and 487.190.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all 3 subsections on employing a family court administrator, support/cooperative service duties, and funding of transferred personnel.

headings.title: Transfer of criminal intra-family actions to family court
headings.reviewNote: Permits transfer of criminal cases between family members upon joint approval of criminal judge and administrative judge.

headings.title: Preservation of rights of criminal defendants
headings.reviewNote: Provides that no provision of subsection 1 shall abridge any of the rights of a criminal defendant.

headings.title: Jurisdiction over joined tort actions and written party retention stipulations
headings.reviewNote: Excludes joined tort actions from family court jurisdiction to civil dockets absent written party stipulation.

headings.title: Probate minor guardianship transfers and post-judgment administration
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes probate transfer of minor guardianships to family court, returning to probate division for final administration.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all 4 subsections on intra-family criminal transfers, criminal defendant rights (tightened subsection 2 title), joined tort actions, and probate minor guardianship transfers.

headings.title: Definition of medication-assisted treatment for substance use disorders
headings.reviewNote: Defines medication-assisted treatment combining medications with counseling and behavioral therapies.

headings.title: Prohibition on restricting physician-directed medication-assisted treatment
headings.reviewNote: Bars family courts from prohibiting or requiring participants to refrain from physician-directed medication-assisted treatment.

headings.title: Compliance protection for participants in medication-assisted treatment
headings.reviewNote: Protects participants from program violations solely on the basis of receiving physician-directed medication-assisted treatment.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all 3 subsections defining medication-assisted treatment and barring family courts from prohibiting or penalizing physician-directed MAT participation.
